extension.summary: Auto-launches TV Slideshow after a period of inactivity
extension.description: Runs quietly in the background. Once nothing has played and there has been no remote input for the number of minutes set in this addon's own Settings screen ("Idle minutes before auto-start") - counted from whichever is more recent, the last remote press or the last time something finished playing - it launches the TV Slideshow addon automatically, screensaver-style, while still leaving Left/Right/Back fully interactive. Does nothing while video/audio is playing or while the slideshow is already running.
